metadata.title: Normalise a String with Strip, Lower, and Split
metadata.description: Clean up a messy string by trimming, lowercasing, and splitting it on spaces.

instructions.main: Normalise `text = "  Ada LOVELACE  "` to `"ada lovelace"`: strip the outer spaces, lowercase it, split on single spaces, and print the words joined by single spaces.
steps: Lowercase with `.lower()`, then split on the space character: `.split(" ")`.
Join with a single space and print the result.

hints.message: Start with `text.strip().lower()`, then `.split(" ")` and join with a space before printing.
`split("")` is not allowed — an empty separator raises ValueError. Use `.split(" ")` to split on spaces (or `.split()` with no arguments).

evaluation.feedback_on_all_pass: You trimmed, lowercased, and split the string correctly.

test_cases.feedback_on_fail: Print exactly `ada lovelace` — strip the outer spaces first, then lowercase and split on single spaces.
Use `.strip()` to remove the outer spaces and `.split(" ")` to split the words.
